manual_evidence.supports: Board orientation and J2/JP2 connector location.
Expansion IO is 3.3 V; direct 5 V signals are prohibited.

header_supply_reference.J2.11: 5 V - not an FPGA IO pull-up rail

electrical_requirements: Confirm the same board revision and connector mapping before applying power.
Use an appropriate MAX30102 breakout with FPGA-facing 3.3 V I2C compatibility; the bare sensor is not assumed 3.3 V tolerant.
Open-drain SCL/SDA require pull-ups to a mutually compatible voltage and a shared ground; do not use HDMI DDC.
verification_scope: Manual-verified connector mapping and completed sensor-integration board functional test. Numeric accuracy and detailed instrument records are separate test items.
